findings.issue: この is glossed as 'nine'. この means 'this' (demonstrative pre-nominal); 'nine' is a completely wrong gloss, possibly confused with ここの/九.
この is glossed as 'nove' (nine). この means 'este/esta'; the numeric gloss teaches a false meaning.
kana inserts きごう ('kigou' = symbol) twice where the jp has spaces. The spaces were transcribed as the word きごう, corrupting the phonetic reading.
findings.current: さむいからきごうまどをきごうしめてください
findings.suggested: さむいからまどをしめてください

findings.issue: romaji contains 'kigou' twice, inherited from the kana bug where spaces were transcribed as きごう. Not the known punctuation/katakana issue.
Token whose surface is a space character has reading きごう ('symbol'). A whitespace token has no reading; this feeds the corrupted kana.
findings.suggested: (null / remove reading; ideally drop the whitespace token)

findings.issue: Second whitespace token also carries the reading きごう ('symbol'). Same defect as tokens[2].
findings.suggested: (null / remove reading; ideally drop the whitespace token)

findings.issue: tokens[0] (お) and tokens[1] (祝い) are stray gloss-less duplicates prepended out of order; the sentence starts at 合格 and お祝い already appears as tokens[4]. Concatenated surfaces do not reconstruct the jp.
findings.current: お + 祝い prepended before 合格
findings.suggested: remove tokens[0] and tokens[1]; keep 合格/の/お祝い/に/花/を/もらっ/た

findings.issue: Literal mirror uses the topic device 'As for...' but the sentence has no は; で marks location. This misrepresents the structure (implies a topic particle that is not there).
findings.current: As for the school entrance, let's meet there.
findings.suggested: At the school's entrance, let's meet.

findings.issue: Espelho literal usa 'Quanto à...' (recurso reservado a は), mas a frase não tem は; で marca o local. Ensina estrutura falsa.
findings.current: Quanto à entrada da escola, vamos nos encontrar.
findings.suggested: Na entrada da escola, vamos nos encontrar.

findings.issue: Typo: 'alguém prática a ação' uses the noun/adjective 'prática' instead of the verb 'pratica'.
findings.current: porque alguém prática a ação sobre a porta
findings.suggested: porque alguém pratica a ação sobre a porta
